campaign-1-taller.name: The Workshop
campaign-1-taller.tagline: Learn the trade by sorting nuts and bolts.

stage-1-fundamentos.name: Toolbox
stage-1-fundamentos.blurb: Sort the toolbox so everything is in its place.

stage-2-presion.name: The tight garage
stage-2-presion.blurb: The car takes up space. Not much room left on the bench.

stage-3-nuevas-reglas.name: The assembly line
stage-3-nuevas-reglas.blurb: Big jobs: nut chains and bolts you need to free up.

20.title: Inspection passed!
20.message: The toolbox passed inspection. Keep sorting before clocking out.

30.title: Toolbox sorted!
30.message: You finished the toolbox. Tomorrow it's the tight garage.

40.title: Torque test!
40.message: You held on with only one free bolt. The garage shows no mercy.

60.title: Garage closed!
60.message: The tight bench no longer intimidates you. The assembly line awaits.

80.title: Quality control!
80.message: You master nut chains. Now it's time to free locked bolts.

100.title: Apprentice graduation!
100.message: You completed the workshop's first section. The bench is yours.

challenge.introLead: Challenges are stage exams with special rules:
challenge.introRule1: You get 3 attempts per cycle. Moving a nut or restarting counts as an attempt.
challenge.introRule2: With 1 or 2 stars you unlock the next level, but you do not earn the medal.
challenge.introRule3: You need 3 stars to beat the challenge and earn the medal.
challenge.introRule4: No undo. If you run out of attempts, you regain 1 every 8 hours (max 3).
challenge.blockedMessage: You used all attempts in this cycle. Keep playing other levels while you wait.

endOfContent.title: You reached the end of the workshop!
endOfContent.message: You completed all available levels. While we prepare more jobs in the workshop, you can replay levels you've already done and earn more stars.

author.bio: I build software and enjoy exploring ideas in mobile form. Nuts & Bolts started as a logic and color puzzle, designed for short play sessions.
